one_line_reason: The sole shortlisted human trial tested a topical wild yam cream, not an oral supplement, and found no significant effect versus placebo.
blockers: Wrong route of exposure: the only shortlisted RCT used a topical cream, not an oral product, so it does not represent this catalog ingredient's exposure.

excluded_pmids.reason: Double-blind crossover RCT of a topical wild yam extract cream (not an oral supplement) in menopausal women; found no significant difference from placebo on menopausal symptoms, lipids, or sex hormones.
